parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: DBName
parameters.description: The database name. You can call the DescribeDatabases operation to query the database name.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-postgres-extensions --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --db-instance-id pgm-bp156o9ti4930000 --db-name test_db --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds DescribePostgresExtensions --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmy0000' --DBInstanceId 'pgm-bp156o9ti4930000' --DBName test_db --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000
